photo.fileTitle: File:Martin Luther King Jr National Historic Site (36233249121).jpg
photo.caption: Martin Luther King Jr. was a leader in the civil rights movement, one of the most famous social movements of the 20th century.
photo.description: Martin Luther King Jr grew up in a time of extreme segregation, but he did not let that stop him from being a dreamer. He had a dream that would resonate with his country, and he became a major leader of the civil rights movement. His story is told at the national park site that includes his childhood home and in the church where he moved hearts and changed minds. www.nps.gov/malu
